subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-08-20
html:

/blog/google-ads-reporting-for-agencies (new)New ~1,330-word guide to Google Ads reporting for agencies — the 5 metrics that belong in a client-facing report, why MCC account-switching (not analysis) is the real time sink, a weekly/monthly/quarterly cadence breakdown, and a plain report-template structure — then how ARLO's Google Ads connector answers it live from Claude. Every product claim reused only what's already live on the Google Ads MCP page, including its honest “Quality Score and search-term reports aren't supported yet” caveat. BlogPosting schema auto-generated via the existing blog pipeline.google ads reporting — pulled live this session: 390/mo, KD 30, CPC $12.66. This is the highest-volume P1 keyword in the entire audit that has never had a page. Secondaries (all lower KD): google ads reporting tool (140/mo, KD 20), google ads report template (110/mo, KD 14), advertising reporting (170/mo, KD 14).askarlo.app/blog/google-ads-reporting-for-agencies

How this one was picked: the last session flagged that the original 12-post content plan was exhausted, so this session re-scoped from a fresh live SE Ranking pull instead of the stale list. Two candidates were checked and rejected: automated reporting tools and automated marketing reports are both in clear 12-month decline, and meta ads reporting (110/mo, KD 18 — genuinely good) was skipped because Meta Ads still isn't a live connector, so a post targeting it would advertise something that doesn't exist yet.

Needs your attention — time-sensitive: catalog.ts lists Mailchimp with an ETA of August 2026 — the first connector ETA that isn't already overdue. If it ships this month it unlocks the first new connector landing page in 4+ months. Meta Ads (3+ months overdue), HubSpot and MailerLite (both past due) are all still unchanged.

Needs your attention (unchanged): off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is still 0 of 6 — the most overdue item on the whole 12-week plan. Needs a human with a browser; this sandbox has no outbound HTTP. Search Console sitemap submission is also still pending from kickoff.

Next: a full weekly-pulse session (backlinks, CI status, rank positions across the 22 tracked keywords) is due — last one was 2026-08-14, next lands 2026-08-21. A meta ads reporting post is queued but gated on Meta Ads going live.
